name: rails_exception_log-assets
description: Builds app/assets/javascripts/rails_exception_log/application.js, the prebuilt bundle the gem ships (Turbo, Stimulus and the engine's controllers). Not published to npm.

scripts.build: bun build app/javascript/rails_exception_log/application.js --minify --format=iife --banner='/*! RailsExceptionLog bundle; includes Turbo and Stimulus (MIT) */' --outfile=app/assets/javascripts/rails_exception_log/application.js
